name: stormbringer-wind-shock-pet-scaling-8386
contract: Wind Shock (Pet) 892101 is cast by the Stormbringer's Air Elemental (summoned by 804019, entry 500941).
Its DBC description is '$m1*$<scalingbp>' Nature damage plus a lingering tick: both effect 0 (periodic
damage) and effect 1 (direct SCHOOL_DAMAGE) carry EffectBasePoints 122/DieSides 1 (raw value 123).
which multiplies a matched effect's base value by ScalingBase(ownerLevel) = 0.0267291844 + 0.0048541098*L +
0.0001859598*L^2 using the pet's owner's level. Before the fix the table entry {892101, 1} set EffectMask to
bit 0 only, so effect 1 (the direct hit) kept the raw 123 at any level: exactly the reported 123 damage at
character level 2. The fix is {892101, 3} (bits 0 and 1), matching precedent entries such as {891051, 3}.
At level 2, ScalingBase = 0.0371812431, so 123 * that = ~4.57; at level 80, ScalingBase = 1.6052,
so 123 * that = ~197.4. Both effects must show this scaled value at both levels once the table bit is added.
